label: Accessible name of a Space's Radar tab. {{space}} is the Space's name. "Space" is a product noun (a shared area of pages).
description: Subtitle under the Space's name on its Radar tab: a view of what changed recently, what's still open and what may be out of date across its pages.
refresh: Button that loads the radar again.
refresh-label: Accessible name of the Refresh button.
missing: Shown when the Space doesn't exist or the person can't read it.
loading: On a Space's Radar tab while it loads.
scope: Explains the radar's scope. {{count}} is how many pages the Space has; {{days}} the stale threshold in days. "Markers" are keywords found in a page (todo, decision…); a dismissal hides an entry until the tab closes.
recent.title: Section heading: pages changed most recently.
recent.empty: In the Radar's recently changed section when the Space has no pages.
open.title: Section heading: pages that carry an open decision or experiment.
open.empty: The <em> tags wrap marker keywords the radar looks for in pages; keep them in English, as the radar matches them literally.
stale.title: Section heading: pages that may be out of date.
stale.empty: {{count}} is the stale threshold in days.
stale.today: On a stale page's card: it was edited today.
stale.age: On a stale page's card: {{count}} is the days since its last edit.
stale.dismiss: Button that hides a stale page's card for this session.
resolved: Button that hides an open decision's card for this session.
clear: Link that shows the cards hidden this session again. {{count}} is how many are hidden.
untitled: A page with no title, shown in its place.
revisions: After a page's last-edited date: {{count}} earlier versions kept in its history.
ago-days: Tooltip on a page's date: how long ago it changed, in days ({{days}} is negative, for the past).
ago-months: Tooltip on a page's date: how long ago it changed, in months ({{months}} is negative, for the past).
